Re-established in {{Start date and age|df=y|1997}} | ground = [[Hiiu Stadium]] | capacity = 570 | chrtitle = President | chairman = Kuno Tehva | manager = [[Nikita Andreev]] | league = [[Meistriliiga]] | season = [[2025 Meistriliiga|2025]] | position = Meistriliiga, 3rd of 10 | website = {{URL|http://www.jkkalju.ee}} | pattern_la1 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_b1 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_ra1 = _adidasicon25ub | pattern_sh1 = _adidassquadra25bb | pattern_so1 = _color_3_stripes_white | leftarm1 = 000000 | body1 = 000000 | rightarm1 = 000000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _adidasicon25lg | pattern_b2 = _adidasicon25lg | pattern_ra2 = _adidasicon25lg | pattern_sh2 = _adidassquadra25lglg | pattern_so2 = _color_3_stripes_white | leftarm2 = BFBFBF | body2 = BFBFBF | rightarm2 = BFBFBF | shorts2 = BFBFBF | socks2 = BFBFBF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Nõmme Kalju FC''' ({{IPA|et|ˈnɤmːe ˈkɑlju|et}}), commonly known as '''Nõmme Kalju''', or simply as '''Kalju''' (Estonian: "rock" or "cliff"), is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Nõmme]], [[Tallinn]], that competes in the [[Meistriliiga]], the top flight of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]]. The club's home ground is [[Hiiu Stadium]]. Founded in 1923, Nõmme Kalju first played in the Estonian top division from 1925 until 1927, but were dissolved in 1944 due to the Soviet occupation of Estonia. Re-established in 1997, the club has played in the Meistriliiga since the [[2008 Meistriliiga|2008 season]] and have not been relegated since. Kalju have won two Meistriliiga titles ([[2012 Meistriliiga|2012]] and [[2018 Meistriliiga|2018]]), two [[Estonian Cup]]s ([[2014–15 Estonian Cup|2014–15]] and [[2024–25 Estonian Cup|2024–25]]), and two [[Estonian Supercup|Estonian Supercups]] (2019 and 2026)."}}
